run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to compare actual test output against the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running all gtest commands with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing locations, stack traces, and time information
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from a Google Test program output using regex substitution
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified test cases from googletest output by matching a regex pattern
